title: CSS properties typography colors backgrounds surfaces effects motion and specialized features
concepts: CSS properties are organized into interoperating modules; each module defines value grammar, inheritance, rendering effects, and interactions.
Typography properties control font selection, shaping, spacing, line construction, text decoration, and language-sensitive layout.
Color, image, border, background, and masking properties describe how boxes and their contents are painted.
Transforms, filters, animations, and transitions change visual presentation over time and create effects that can influence stacking and compositing.
Specialized property families support SVG, MathML, generated content, UI affordances, view transitions, and other platform capabilities.
Property names and specification status are distinct from browser support; experimental entries need compatibility review.

versionNotes.edition: CSS Snapshot 2026 and modular CSS specifications
items: CSS has no single annual language version: modules progress independently. The 2026 CSS Snapshot is a W3C Group Note describing the stable specification set, not a browser-support guarantee or a monolithic CSS 2026 feature release.

The 2026 snapshot supersedes the previous snapshot as the latest published stable-specification profile. Newer draft modules and properties remain separately identified by their specification status; check implementation support before using them.

The property inventory includes standardized names, vendor-prefixed extensions, aliases, and experimental or draft entries from the pinned MDN data snapshot. Names in the inventory do not imply standardization, interoperability, or recommendation for production use.
